LESSON: KUANDIKA 9.3.1 INSHA ZA MAELEZO

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.3: Kuandika 9.3.1 Insha za Maelezo

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kuandika 9.3.1 Insha za Maelezo. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kueleza maudhui ya insha ya maelezo kwa kuzingatia mada
2. kuandika insha ya maelezo kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo ili kufanikisha mawasiliano

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kueleza maudhui ya insha ya maelezo kwa kuzingatia mada
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza maudhui ya insha ya maelezo kwa kuzingatia mada. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kuandika insha ya maelezo kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo ili kufanikisha mawasiliano
   In simple words: practise until you can kuandika insha ya maelezo kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo ili kufanikisha mawasiliano. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kuandika 9.3.1 Insha za Maelezo using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kuandika 9.3.1 Insha za Maelezo in the examples.
2. Explain Kuandika 9.3.1 Insha za Maelezo to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kuandika 9.3.1 Insha za Maelezo.
4. Show that you can: kueleza maudhui ya insha ya maelezo kwa kuzingatia mada

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 9.3.1 Insha za Maelezo using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 9.3.1 Insha za Maelezo important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kueleza maudhui ya insha ya maelezo kwa kuzingatia mada
2. kuandika insha ya maelezo kwa kufuata kanuni zifaazo ili kufanikisha mawasiliano

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
